name: FirstLight Robinhood Chain sequencer feed
notes: FirstLight's documentation index lists four keyed endpoints: the Robinhood Chain sequencer feed, served as a standard Arbitrum Nitro feed at wss://blocks.first-light.stream/{KEY}, which the feed page says a Nitro node reads with --node.feed.input.url; a block headers stream at wss://headers.first-light.stream/{KEY}, which the headers page places in the Free plan; a raw signed transactions stream at wss://tx.first-light.stream/{KEY}; and transaction submission by eth_sendRawTransaction at https://submit.first-light.stream/{KEY}, which the submit page says answers eth_chainId with chain ID 4663. Every endpoint takes a key as its path, and the documentation says FirstLight issues keys on request.
